name: Maximum Face-Prime Obstruction
definition: The displayed class in $Q_6$ whose low-bit vertex-incidence mask is `0x1111bf00b0b1b080`; bit $j$ records the word with integer encoding $j$.
properties: A 22-vertex maximum VC-dimension-two ample partial cube that is periphery-free and pc-minimal outside the cover-recursively peripheral class. It is obtained by six displayed restrictions of Hall's 299-concept class. It is gated-prime and cubical-face-prime: it has 77 proper gated coordinate faces but no proper gated two-cover.
